name: Kjell Group AB
summary: Kjell Group AB (publ) engages in the sale of various consumer electronics accessories in Sweden, Denmark, and Norway. It also provides installation, advisory, and technical support services. The company sells its products through own stores, reseller platforms, sourcing companies, proprietary brands, distribution partners, and online channels. Kjell Group AB (publ) was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.
